title: Resolve contradictory current DAO Target Descriptor requirements
description: spec/05-routing.md §8.7 normatively restricts current .44.7 to exactly one self /128 Target and says implementations MUST NOT infer Target Descriptor support, while §8.8 normatively says one-or-more Targets with optional Target Descriptors and receivers MUST allow them. Python authenticated validation/vectors reject descriptors. Make current-profile requirements unambiguous and move multi-target/descriptor grouping wholly into the future generalized profile, preserving exact vector behavior.
